logo.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Generate one minimal horizontal logo for the teacher workspace "tiza". Compact abstract lowercase t symbol formed from two bold rounded chalk strokes beside the exact lowercase word "tiza" in friendly confident geometric sans lettering. Solid cobalt blue #0866e6 on pure white. Crisp smooth flat vector-like shapes, generous margin. No gradients, texture, shadows, mockups, slogans, sparkles or extra symbols. One logo only; intended for conversion to SVG paths.
logo.conversion: alpha threshold 160, VTracer 0.6.12 binary spline paths

video.prompt: A cobalt-blue chalk stroke bursts into eight distinct flowing chalk paths across warm ivory paper. Premium tactile macro film for an education brand, 16:9. One continuous camera pull-back, crisp raking studio light revealing real chalk grain. 0–3 seconds: extreme close view of blue chalk drawing a decisive stroke, tiny powder particles kicked up by the contact. 3–7 seconds: the camera pulls back as the stroke branches into eight orderly curved paths, accented by small golden-yellow and coral chalk fragments. 7–10 seconds: the eight paths settle into a balanced open composition, plenty of clean ivory negative space at center for a logo added in post. Physical dry chalk and paper, deliberate real-time motion, beautiful editorial product photography, no neon, no liquid morphing, no faces, no readable text, no letters, no logo, no captions. Silent picture; dialogue and sound effects will be added separately.

script.text: [sighs] Class is over. My work isn't. Eight learners... eight different starting points.
[reassuring] Let's take it one step at a time. Choose the goal. I'll prepare practice for each learner.
[curious] And I get to check it first?
[warmly] Of course. Review the activities, approve this version, then publish. Your class. Your call.
[thoughtful] They practise... but how do I know what to teach next?
[confident] Every answer leaves evidence. See who needs help, and bring that into your next lesson. [warmly] You teach. Tiza takes care of practice between classes.
